chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakūnī, he said:
Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: “An eye is not to be assessed on a cloudy day.”

key_terms.تُقَاسُ: is measured or assessed in a legal evaluative sense
key_terms.عَيْنٌ: the eye, referring here to bodily injury assessment
key_terms.يَوْمِ غَيْمٍ: a cloudy day, when proper visual assessment is impaired

ai.seo_question: Why should an eye not be assessed for legal compensation on a cloudy day?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about assessing an eye injury, stating that such evaluation should not be done on a cloudy day. The implication is that accurate legal assessment in bodily injury cases depends on clear conditions and reliable examination.
